basic_info.description:
Great Home in the Heart of Ingleside
This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home offers comfort and convenience in one of San Francisco's most accessible neighborhoods. Filled with natural light, its the perfect place to enjoy both sunrise and sunset. The spacious kitchen is ideal for hosting, while the garden feels like a natural extension of the bedrooms - offering a peaceful retreat right at your doorstep.
Downstairs, an unwarranted 1-bedroom in-law unit provides excellent potential for extended family living, guest accommodations, or additional workspace.
Perfectly located just minutes from City College, this home is ideal for both commuters and locals. Its only a 5-minute walk to BART, with a quick 10-minute ride to downtown San Francisco. For drivers, the 280 freeway is easily accessible for convenient travel around the Bay Area. You're also just 10 minutes from Sonestown Galleria for shopping, dining, and groceries.
Enjoy everything the thriving neighborhood has to offer, including Whole Foods, Philz Coffee, and the beloved local staple - Beeps Burgers- all just a short stroll
